in_hebrew.name: Haberman
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Haberman הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. This name is derived from the Old German word 'haben', meaning 'to have'. The second part, 'man', is a common Germanic suffix meaning 'man'. Thus, Haberman can be interpreted as 'the one who has a man' or 'the man of the family'.
